components.name: Voltage Regulation Module (VRM)

components.name: Cooling Solution (Heatsink and Fan Assembly)

components.name: Backplate

components.name: Power Connectors (8-pin or 12-pin EPS connectors)

components.name: Display Output Interfaces (HDMI, DisplayPort Modules)
